sentences.text: West Ham United Football Club is a professional football club based in Stratford , East London , England .	football	Association football	Stratford	Stratford, London	East London	East London	England	England national football team
They compete in the Premier League , the top tier of English football .	football	Association football	Premier League	Premier League
In 2016 the club re-located to the London Stadium .	London Stadium	Olympic Stadium (London)
The club was founded in 1895 as Thames Ironworks and reformed in 1900 as West Ham United .	Thames Ironworks	Thames Ironworks F.C.
They moved to the Boleyn Ground in 1904 , which remained their home ground for more than a century .	Boleyn Ground	Boleyn Ground

The team initially competed in the Southern League and Western League before joining the Football League in 1919 .	Southern League	Southern Football League	Western League	Western Football League	Football League	The Football League

They were promoted to the top flight in 1923 , when they were also losing finalists in the first FA Cup Final held at Wembley .	FA Cup Final	1923 FA Cup Final	Wembley	Wembley Stadium (1923)	FA Cup	FA Cup	1923	1923 FA Cup Final
In 1940 , the club won the inaugural Football League War Cup .	Football League	The Football League	Football League War Cup	Football League War Cup

West Ham have been winners of the FA Cup three times , in 1964 , 1975 , and 1980 , and have also been runners-up twice , in 1923 , and 2006 .	FA Cup	FA Cup	1964	1964 FA Cup Final	1975	1975 FA Cup Final	1980	1980 FA Cup Final	1923	1923 FA Cup Final	2006	2006 FA Cup Final

The club have reached two major European finals , winning the European Cup Winners ' Cup in 1965 and finishing runners-up in the same competition in 1976 .	1965	1964–65 European Cup Winners' Cup	1976	1975–76 European Cup Winners' Cup
West Ham also won the Intertoto Cup in 1999 .	Intertoto Cup	Intertoto Cup

They are one of eight clubs never to have fallen below the second tier of English football , spending 59 of 91 league seasons in the top flight , up to and including the 2016 -- 17 season .	football	Association football
The club 's highest league position to date came in 1985 -- 86 when they achieved third place in the then First Division .	First Division	Football League First Division
